3.title: Semantic B-roll and media intelligence
verified: sidecar tags and description read, sanitised (lowercase, de-duplicated, length-capped)
lexical retrieval over tags (weight 3), description (2), file name (1); IDF weighting

no match is invented: an unlisted synonym returns nothing (tested)
licence gate: unknown-licence assets excluded on request (query and plan)
near-duplicates (same hash or dHash within 5 bits) are not returned twice
scene B-roll assignment: each asset used once; unfilled scenes say why (used elsewhere, or below threshold)
generated visuals (chart, graphics, map, text, negative space) receive no footage
video motion = scene cuts per second, measured with ffmpeg on synthetic clips (static 0, one cut counted)
metric cache keyed by content hash; changed files re-measured; sidecar text never served from cache; unreadable cache ignored
CLI: python3 -m uvs.retrieval (query or plan mode)

visual content analysis of footage (subject, colour meaning, faces)
subject or camera motion; only scene-cut rate is measured
shot-level assignment (scene level only)

no real-footage library tested

CLI and synthetic demo (examples/motion_demo)

keyframes on timeline clips (only scene-graph nodes)
motion blur; sub-pixel anti-aliasing beyond PIL bilinear
performance tuning (full-frame layers; no tiling or caching of transformed layers)
no reference-image regression set
